decision: Approve the host-fill convention (fill) for Panel and Tabs without changing any existing component contract.

limits: Binds only the host-fill convention payload below; fullWidth, sticky, maxHeight, layout and filled keep their existing meanings and approvals.
Every existing Panel and Tabs API is unchanged; no migration is implied.

convention.name: fill
convention.meaning: Opt in to filling a definite-height host's block size, with fixed chrome and an internal native scrolling region; absence keeps content-sized height.
convention.whenToUse: A component sits in a host that owns a definite height and should keep its header, footer or tab list fixed while one inner region scrolls natively.
convention.avoid: Inline-axis width (fullWidth), positioning (sticky), height caps (maxHeight), arrangement (layout) or solid glyph rendering (filled).
